title: Integral kernel model of a surjective rational matrix
statement: Let F be scalar extension from continuous integral coefficients to E and G its right adjoint, for [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. If X is compact and f:F(O_X^n)→F(O_X^m) is epi, then the kernel of its integral adjoint O_X^n→G(F(O_X^m)) is isomorphic to kernel(g) for an integral matrix g:O_X^n→O_X^m such that F(g) is epi.

source.place: Section 6.8, coefficient localization and Lemma 6.8.13, first paragraph; agent intersection/matrix variant

proof.text: The coefficient inclusion is monic by the explicit continuous-function realization. For the regular module, the extension unit followed by the restricted regular-extension isomorphism is that inclusion. On a finite free module, naturality with every coordinate projection therefore proves monicity of the unit.
Clear the denominators of f, obtaining F(g)=ℓ^k f. Powers of ℓ are invertible on rational modules, as follows from module_nsmul_isIso and induction; consequently F(g) remains epi.

Naturality of the unit identifies g followed by the target unit with ℓ^k times the adjoint of f. Postcomposition by either the monic unit or the invertible rational scalar does not change a kernel, by Mathlib kernelCompMono. Transport along this equality to obtain the displayed isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem integralFiniteFree_kernel_model (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : Type) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] (n m : ℕ)
    (f : (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).obj
        (Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) n) ⟶
      (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).obj
        (Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) m)) [Epi f] :
    ∃ g : Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) n ⟶
        Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) m,
      Epi ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).map g) ∧
      Nonempty (kernel ((Mod.extendRestrictAdjunction
        (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).homEquiv _ _ f) ≅ kernel g)
